newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fuji Bank to issue 210 bln yen preferred stock.
newsitem.headline: Fuji Bank to issue 210 bln yen preferred stock.

text.p: Fuji Bank Ltd said on Friday that it would issue 210 billion yen worth of preferred stock.
The bank said 70 million shares of convertible preferred stock, each worth 3,000 yen, would be issued and 1,500 yen of each share issued would go to bank capital.
The payment date is December 27 and the dividend for the new shares would be decided at a board meeting to be held later, the bank said in a statement.
It said the preferred stock would be issued overseas and owners could convert them into ordinary shares from July 1, 1997 until the end of January 31, 2002.
The stock issue was designed to strengthen the bank's capital base, it said.
